1.title: 1 – Card Translation
1.body: All remaining French cards have been translated into English.

2.title: 2 – Deck Builder Fixes & Improvements
2.body: Fixed a bug preventing players from creating multiple decks. Updated the Deck Builder interface to be fully responsive on mobile devices.

3.title: 3 – Mantris Marionette Card
3.body: Resolved an issue causing turn-related problems when using the Mantris Marionette card.

4.title: 4 – Phantom Turn
4.body: The game no longer displays the interface to a player who cannot act during their turn. Now, if you cannot perform any action, the game simply prompts you to end your turn.

5.title: 5 – Landing Page & Dashboard Fixes
5.body: Fixed multiple integration issues affecting the landing page and the dashboard.

6.title: 6 – Discord Link Added
6.body: Added a direct link to the game's official Discord server on the landing page.
